title: The Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society (Formation) Act, 1976.
full_text: The Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society (Formation) Act, 1976. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197654 Act Number: 54 Enactment Date: 1976-08-18 Act Year: 1976 Short Title: The Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society (Formation) Act, 1976. Long Title: An Act to provide for the formation of Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society Limited, by amalgamation of the Andhra Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society Limited, the Hyderabad Handloom Weavers Central Co-operative Association Limited, and the Rayalaseema Apex Weavers Co-operative Society Limited and for matters connected therewith and incidental thereto. Department: Department of Industries and Commerce Enforcement Date: 06-07-1976 Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Formation of the Telangana State Handloom Weavers' Co-operative Society Ltd. Section 4. General effect of Amalgamation. Section 5. Ultimate authority of new society to vest in its general body. Section 6. Management of the affairs of the new society. Section 7. Transfer of services of officers and other employees of the amalgamated societies. Section 8. Over-riding effect of the Act. Section 9. Power to make rules. Section 10. Power to remove difficulties. Section 11. Repeal of Ordinance 14 of 1976.
